page: Microsoft Azure E64pds_v6 is an ARM-based virtual machine belonging to the Epdsv6 server family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated physical cores powered by the Microsoft Neoverse-N2 ARM processor operating at 3.4 GHz, with one thread per core. The hardware configuration includes 512.0 GB of RAM, providing 8.0 GB of memory per core, and is bundled with 3780 GB of local NVMe SSD storage.

In benchmark testing, the E64pds_v6 demonstrates top-tier multi-core performance, placing in the top 10% for stress-ng multi-core CPU tests, Geekbench multi-core scores, and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression. Its memory subsystem is highly efficient, achieving top-tier results in large-block read and write memory bandwidth, as well as the Passmark memory score. Single-core performance is moderate, ranking in the middle 50% for stress-ng single-core and Geekbench single-core tests.

The server offers high resource density and qualitative cost efficiency for memory-intensive and storage-heavy workloads due to its ARM architecture and bundled local NVMe SSD. It is highly suitable for database operations, software compilation, and large-scale data processing. The lack of hyperthreading ensures predictable dedicated core performance, making it a strong fit for relational databases, Redis deployments, and memory-optimized enterprise applications.
